title: skills/objectui i18n guide still teaches the zh and pt pack keys that #30511 retires
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf

Filing gate: ③ teaching surface out of date after a declared narrowing. Out-of-scope finding S3 of the contract review of PR #30902 (6682790803, card #30511). `Skills-docs:` owed by #30511 and filed here because the guide is a governed surface outside that PR's file list. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: c · reach: every agent or author that follows the objectui i18n skill guide to set up or switch a console language.

## Business reason

PR #30902 renames the built-in pack keys and module paths `zh` → `zh-Hans` and `pt` → `pt-BR`, adds `zh-Hant`, and makes the platform locale table the list of languages. `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` still lists ten languages keyed `zh` and `pt` (L32–33), shows `resources: { zh: … }` (L16) and a language picker with `value="zh"` (L50). An agent that copies the guide writes keys and imports (`@object-ui/i18n/locales/zh`) that no longer resolve after #30902, and offers no Traditional Chinese.

## Where

- `skills/objectui/guides/i18n.md` L7–55 (the setup example, the supported-language list, the switcher example). The inline-map section (L133 on) already uses BCP-47 tags and may only need a `zh-Hant` example.

## Wanted

1. After PR #30902 lands, rewrite those sections against `main`: the eleven table tags from `PLATFORM_LOCALES`, `zh-Hans` / `zh-Hant` / `pt-BR` keys and module paths, a switcher fed by the table, and a note that stored `zh` / `zh-CN` / `pt` keep resolving through the read aliases.
2. Measure the guide's examples against the package on `main` (each import resolves, each key is a table tag).

**Level:** docs only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, governed surface (Tier H).

Reader: `domain:skills`.
Serial: after PR #30902 (#30511).
Related: #30511, PR #30902.
